title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: rfile
text:
R-file
R-file
(data structure)
Definition:
A
spatial access method
which divides space into a hierarchically of nested boxes.  Objects are indexed in the lowest cell which completely contains them.
See also
BANG file
.
Note:
After
[GG98]
.
